description:
[DEPRECATED — use the typed transition tools (claim, report_progress, submit_for_review, resolve_review, block, unblock) instead. This tool will be removed in a future release.] Atomically advance or update the kanban status of a feature or user story. Validates allowed state transitions and prevents invalid moves. Works for features and user stories only. Acceptance criteria cannot be moved with this tool: use vibemap_claim_criterion, vibemap_report_progress, vibemap_submit_for_review, vibemap_block_criterion and vibemap_unblock_criterion, which record who moved what and why.

Feature stages: draft → open → in_progress → completed
Story stages: draft → has_criteria → open → in_progress → completed

entityId.description: ID of the feature, story, or criterion

notes.description: Optional context about why this transition was made

name: vibemap_update_kanban_status
